data.name: Zamar
data.long_meaning: One who protects, defends or keeps safe. Derived from the verb 'zamaara' meaning 'to protect'. It can also be associated with melodies and music as the word 'zamar' is used in Arabic to refer to a type of percussion instrument used in traditional music. A beautiful and meaningful name for a child.
data.spiritual_meaning: Zamar is a name with deep spiritual significance. It represents the guardian angel or protector that is always with us, watching over us and keeping us safe from harm. It is a reminder of the divine presence and protection that we have in our lives, and a call to trust in Allah's care and guidance.
